claims.reason: Backed: the need check (art. 12 ust. 6 allows only information necessary to confirm identity and only with reasonable doubts; UODO says no more data than necessary and that existing login mechanisms should suffice). Not backed: the 'kanał' part (checking the channel before sending an identity document). Neither snapshot says anything about the security or authenticity of the channel, nor names an identity document specifically.

claims.claim: Tekst opisuje przepisy ogólnie, nie jest poradą prawną i nie miał przeglądu prawnika.

scope_gaps.note: Art. 15 ust. 3 lets the controller charge a reasonable fee for further copies; the sentence says 'co do zasady' and does not mention it.

The RODO snapshot is the Polish text as published in Dz.Urz. UE L 119 of 4.5.2016; later corrigenda or a consolidated version were not in the snapshot. Polish implementing law was not checked and is not claimed.
Art. 12 ust. 3 sets the time to inform the person about the action taken; it does not say the action itself must be finished within the month. The sentence says 'odpowiedź', which fits.

The UODO page in the snapshot explains the right to erasure (plus the deadline and identity check); it does not explain access or rectification, so 'wyjaśnienie UODO' supports mainly the erasure part of the item.
The UODO page's advice on wording the request (cite the right, specify the data) concerns erasure only; applying it to access and rectification requests is an editorial extension.

The regulation says the right to a copy 'nie może niekorzystnie wpływać na prawa i wolności innych' (must not adversely affect); the item writes 'nie może naruszać', which a reader may take as a higher threshold than the text sets.
The sources speak of 'dodatkowe informacje niezbędne do potwierdzenia tożsamości' in general; they do not mention an identity document or the choice of channel.

notes: Only AGENTS.md, .claude/agents/pl-source-verifier.md, the packet and the two named snapshots were opened (the large RODO snapshot was read in parts: lines 1-80 and 2640-3040, plus pinned Grep searches with the exact snapshot path). Nothing outside the allowed set was opened. Short heading quotes ('Artykuł 12', 'Artykuł 15', 'Artykuł 16', 'Artykuł 17') use cell:true although they are headings, not table cells, because the article numbers sit alone on their lines; if the script rejects this, the numbers 12, 15, 16, 17 have no longer quote in the same context.
